data.one_liner: An alternative to Firebase Dynamic Links handling deep links on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: SojoLink provides an alternative SDK to Firebase Dynamic Links, offering similar APIs and setup to handle incoming deep links and UTM parameters. It uses a stream-based approach to listen for pending dynamic links on Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You are migrating away from Firebase Dynamic Links prior to its shutdown.
You need to capture deep links and UTM parameters in your Flutter app for Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You are using backend services other than SojoLink for dynamic links.
You only require basic web routing without dynamic link shorteners.
strengths: Similar API and setup to Firebase Dynamic Links for easy migration.
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.
Depends on a specific third-party backend service (sojolink.com).
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a SojoLink account, configuring apps on the dashboard, adding intent filters in AndroidManifest.xml, and setting up URL schemes and associated domains in Info.plist for iOS.
